_comment: Planned trigger configuration for uipath.connector.trigger.uipath-microsoft-outlook365.email-received (nodeId: emailReceivedOutlook3651). Apply via: uip maestro flow node configure OutlookTriggerFlow.flow emailReceivedOutlook3651 --detail "$(cat trigger_detail.json)" --output json
connectionId: <PLACEHOLDER: UUID of your Microsoft Outlook 365 Integration Service connection — obtain with: uip is connections list "uipath-microsoft-outlook365" --all-folders --output json>
folderKey: <PLACEHOLDER: Orchestrator folder key that owns the connection above — obtain from the connections list response: Data[*].FolderKey>

eventParameters.parentFolderId: <PLACEHOLDER: Inbox folder ID — resolve with: uip is resources run list "uipath-microsoft-outlook365" "MailFolder" --connection-id <connectionId> --output json>

queryParameters.sharedMailboxAddress: <OPTIONAL: leave empty for the authenticated user's own mailbox; set to a shared-mailbox address if monitoring a delegated inbox>

_meta.filterDescription: Fires when an email arrives in the monitored Inbox folder, sent by abc@xyz.com, with a subject that contains 'good day'. Both conditions are AND-ed (groupOperator: 0).

filterFields.from: Sender email address — matched with Equals operator
filterFields.subject: Email subject line — matched with Contains operator

resolveBeforeConfigure: connectionId — run: uip is connections list "uipath-microsoft-outlook365" --all-folders --output json
folderKey — from the same connections list response (FolderKey field on the chosen connection)
parentFolderId — run: uip is resources run list "uipath-microsoft-outlook365" "MailFolder" --connection-id <connectionId> --output json, pick the Inbox entry's id
_meta.configureCommand: uip maestro flow node configure OutlookTriggerFlow.flow emailReceivedOutlook3651 --detail "$(cat trigger_detail_filled.json)" --output json
